definitions.explanation: An immediate understanding or knowing something without conscious reasoning; a hunch or sixth sense.

examples.japanese: {直感|ちょっかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。
{直感|ちょっかん}{的|てき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I intuitively sensed it was dangerous.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{直感|ちょっかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鋭|するど}く→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧。
examples.english: Her intuition is sharp and always correct.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {直感|ちょっかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧ - to trust one's intuition
- {直感|ちょっかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ - intuition works/kicks in
- {直感|ちょっかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧ - to have sharp intuition
- {直感|ちょっかん}{的|てき}（な） - intuitive

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {直感|ちょっかん} - immediate understanding without reasoning (cognitive)
- ⟦{本能|ほんのう}→本能：07623_honnou⟧ - innate, biological drives (instinct)
- ⟦{勘|かん}→勘：02149_kan⟧ - a more casual word for intuition/hunch

USAGE:
The suru verb form {直感|ちょっかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means "to sense intuitively."
